inference: one global nondecreasing five-depth vector; no exact fidelity, answer, oracle, or attainable-level feature is read at inference
selection_rule: enumerate all nondecreasing five-depth vectors from 0..12; maximize five-anchor Complete count on train-side queries, then maximize 0.90 successes, then minimize mean normalized five-anchor context tokens, then lexicographically earliest vector
evaluation_role: exactly one read of previously design-exposed fold4=611 after the vector is fixed; compare same-order CUT-B0 and oracle ceilings
metrics: all-query mean normalized legal context tokens
Complete-only mean normalized oracle token regret
interpretation: fixed schedule is a necessary depth-only control, not evidence of learned per-query safe-window recognition; a quality-only gain with higher tokens is not final Pareto improvement
